name: @sbluemin/fleet-agent-core
description: General-purpose agent with transport abstraction, state management, and attachment support

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const path = require('node:path'); fs.writeFileSync('.tsconfig.build.tsc.json', JSON.stringify({ extends: path.resolve('tsconfig.build.json'), compilerOptions: { paths: {} } }));" && tsc -p .tsconfig.build.tsc.json --target ES2024 --lib ES2024 && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.tsconfig.build.tsc.json', { force: true })"
scripts.dev: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const path = require('node:path'); fs.writeFileSync('.tsconfig.build.tsc.json', JSON.stringify({ extends: path.resolve('tsconfig.build.json'), compilerOptions: { paths: {} } }));" && tsc -p .tsconfig.build.tsc.json --target ES2024 --lib ES2024 --watch --preserveWatchOutput
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build

author: sbluemin
